title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Geography Paper 1 (Physical Geography)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Geography 0460 Paper 1 (Physical Geography): one compulsory 25-mark question in Section A and a choice of 25-mark questions in Section B, answer two, 1 hour 45 minutes, 75 marks, on changing river and coastal environments, ecosystems, tectonic hazards and climate change. This practice paper offers four Section B questions where the real paper offers three. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer the question in Section A and **two** questions from Section B. You have 1 hour 45 minutes.

- Each question is worth 25 marks. If you answer more than two in Section B, your best two count.
- Where a question asks for a detailed example, name a specific place and give precise detail.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 1 of the 2027-2029 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
